title: Coordinate switching failure probability
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates, let $\\delta\\in\\mathbb R$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The coordinate switching failure probability is the sum over all assignments of the three restriction statuses to the $n$ coordinates, with each assignment weighted by its restriction-assignment weight at parameter $\\delta$, of the corresponding coordinate switching failure indicator at threshold $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates
caveat: The formal statement relies on omitted definitions of restriction-assignment weights and decision-tree depth.
